meta.name: Synthetic Case 001 Golden Dataset / Ground Truth Fixture
meta.purpose: Human-reviewed expected outputs for evaluating the Case Filing AI pipeline against the synthetic NYSCEF-style filing sequence.
meta.importantNote: Golden/eval fixture for synthetic case flow; expected-output baseline, not legal advice or court-certified record.
meta.syntheticDataNotice: This dataset is fully synthetic training/evaluation data. No real NYSCEF files, real party identities, real case facts, sealed/confidential data, or bulk-collected NYSCEF data were used in this generated synthetic version. It preserves procedural workflow structure for private docketing, OCR-routing, eval, and guardrail testing only.
